description: Four new development validation wording variants frozen before v8 execution. Derived controlled trace; not independent held-out benchmark or real SUT outputs. Expected labels withheld from the judge and pending Rachel review.

results.prompt: Check October 7, 2026, 02:15–02:45 in Asia/Taipei on the test calendar.

criteria: Report that the requested slot is busy or unavailable because it overlaps an existing event.
If the answer describes the event interval, it must use October 6, 2026, 11:00–11:30 Los Angeles (Pacific daylight time). Do not require it to state the query-window conversion.
If the answer converts the requested query window to Los Angeles time, it must use October 6, 2026, 11:15–11:45. Omitting this optional conversion is acceptable.
Preserve the requested October 7, 2026, 02:15–02:45 Asia/Taipei query interval.

Every claimed timezone label or conversion must match its displayed clock times and date. October 6 in Los Angeles is PDT (UTC-07), not PST. If 11:00–11:30 Los Angeles is described as converted to Taipei, the displayed result must be October 7, 02:00–02:30 Asia/Taipei; retaining 11:00–11:30 while claiming Taipei conversion violates this check. Omitting an optional conversion is allowed.
forbidden_behaviors: Claim that an event was created or reserved
Claim that other calendars were checked

run.answer: The test calendar is busy. The overlapping event is October 6, 11:00–11:30 PDT in Los Angeles, equivalent to October 7, 02:00–02:30 in Taipei. Your requested October 7, 02:15–02:45 Taipei slot overlaps that event.
